notes.title: Style update: Introducing eyewear and more hats
notes.notes:
[p][b]New styles, faster loading![/b]
The latest Magnecube update brings a whole new layer of customization and performance:[/p][p]🕶️ [b]Eyewear Arrives[/b]: Express yourself with bold, quirky, or mysterious glasses.
🎩 [b]More Hats[/b]: Even more headwear options to suit your vibe.
⚡ [b]Community Level Boost[/b]: We've significantly improved loading times for community-created levels, so you can jump into the action faster than ever.[/p][p]Mix and match your new look, dive into fan-made challenges, and feel the difference![/p]

notes.title: Magnecube demo now available! Try it for free
notes.notes: [p]The wait is over [b]Magnecube now has a free demo![/b][/p][p]You can finally try out the game and get a taste of the chaos before diving into the full experience. This demo version includes a limited selection of levels and features to help you explore the core gameplay mechanics, feel the magnetic movement, and discover the kind of fast-paced challenges that await you.[/p][p]Whether you're curious about the controls or want to experience the magnetism in action, this demo is the perfect starting point.[/p][p][/p][p]And if you’re enjoying the demo, the full version has a lot more to offer:[/p][list][*][p]Levels beyond level 16 in Story Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]More objects and mechanics to discover.[/p][/*][*][p][b]A level editor[/b] to create and publish your own levels online (ECS account required).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Online mode:[/b] play community-created levels (ECS account required).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam achievements[/b] for completing certain goals.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam inventory:[/b] earn cosmetics through playtime to customize your cube. These can be sold and traded in the Steam Community.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Your save data carries over from the trial to the full version, so you can continue right where you left off.[/p][p][/p][p]Try it out and let us know what you think we’d love your feedback![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]We have also created a new trailer for Magnecube![/p][previewyoutube="GDDtmYEjkbY;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Steam Inventory is here! Unlock wearable hats in Magnecube
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce a brand new feature in Magnecube: full Steam Inventory integration!

[h3]🎁 How it works🎁[/h3]
[list]
[*]You can now earn [b]hats of different rarities[/b] just by playing Magnecube.[/*]
[*]The more you play, the more hats you can unlock, up to a maximum per day.[/*]
[*]All hats go directly to your Steam Inventory and [b]can be consumed and equiped[/b] in-game![/*]
[*]Rarities range from [b]'Basic'[/b] to [b]'Singularity'[/b], some of them with custom logic and effects.[/*]
[/list]
[h3]⏳ Why play now?⏳[/h3]
Each day you play gives you another chance to expand your collection. Jump in and start earning hats before your daily limit resets!


[h3]🧠 What’s next?🧠[/h3]
We’re planning more cosmetics and surprises for active players. Got a favorite hat idea? Let us know in the discussions!


[i]As always, thanks for supporting indie games and experimenting with magnetic madness![/i]

notes.title: 🎉 New Achievements + Localization Update! 🌍
notes.notes: [p]We’ve just added [b]even more achievements[/b] to [i]Magnecube[/i]! Whether you're a casual collector or a hardcore completist, there's now more reason than ever to keep those magnets flying.[/p][p]And that’s not all—[b]achievements are no longer English-only[/b]. We've now localized them into multiple languages so players around the world can enjoy the chaos in their native tongue.[/p][p]Ready to hunt them all? 🔥[/p]

notes.title: Story level 24 added "Flip the Whole Plan!"
notes.notes: [p]We’ve just released Level 24 in Magnecube’s Story Mode, bringing the total to 24 brain-bending, magnet-flipping stages![/p][p]This latest addition introduces a major twist: the [b]polarity switch[/b] mechanic.[/p][quote][p]“Everything is upside down again, magnets change and your brain melts a little more. I don’t even know who I am anymore.”[/p][/quote][p][/p][p]In this new level, polarity changers take center stage. All positive blocks turn negative, and all negatives become positive — instantly transforming how you approach every puzzle.[/p][p]You’ll need to think ahead, plan for sudden shifts, and make sure you don’t get pulled into chaos (literally).[/p][p][/p][p][b]Also fixed[/b]: an issue with the pause menu that didn’t reactivate HTTP correctly — it's all working again now.[/p][p][/p][p]Update now and dive into one of the most mind-twisting levels yet![/p]

notes.title: New Story Level Added – Embrace the Neutrality!
notes.notes: [p]We've just released a brand new level in [i]Magnecube[/i]'s Story Mode, bringing the total to [b]23 magnetic mayhem-filled stages[/b]![/p][p]This new level introduces a fresh mechanic: the [b]neutral state[/b].[/p][quote][p]“There's being positive, there's being negative... and then there's being neutral. Emotionally stable? Maybe. But magnetically? You're invisible.[/p][p]While you're neutral, magnetic cubes will completely ignore you, and you won't be able to magnetize either.[/p][p]Sometimes, the best way to deal with magnetic chaos... is to not participate at all.”[/p][/quote][p]Mastering this new state will be key to navigating the puzzle ahead — sometimes, staying out of the magnetic fray is the smartest move.[/p][p]Update now and discover a new twist in the world of polarity![/p]

notes.title: 🎉 50 Levels created by the community... and counting! 🎉
notes.notes:
🚀 We're Leveling Up... 50 Times Over!

The Magnecube community has just reached a milestone of 50 online levels created by players from around the world!

🧲 Whether you're dodging bombs, bouncing off magnets, or barely surviving a chaotic mess of traps, this is all thanks to YOU, our incredible players.

🎨 A special shoutout goes to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/30793037-Nap%2527n%2527Gaming/]Nap'n'Gaming[/url], who’s been an absolute level-making machine lately! Your creativity is off the charts!

💥 Keep building, keep playing, and let’s blast our way to the next 50.

👉 Got a wild idea? Make it a level. The Magnecubeverse is yours to shape.

notes.title: 🌍 Now Fluent in Italiano, Français, Deutsch, and Português! 🎉
notes.notes:
Hey puzzle fans! We figured Magnecube needed a little je ne sais quoi, ciao bella, hallo!, and olá! So we taught it four new languages: Italian, French, German, and Portuguese.

Now you can get your magnetic cube to speak in your favourite language, no matter where you are on this beautiful planet. Because why limit mind-bending puzzles to just a small portion of language? Time to impress your friends with your fancy linguistic skills while you crush those levels.

Update now and say hello to Magnecube’s new international vibe! 🌟🧲
